name: Pasta with Onion, Bacon and Cream
desc: Pasta tossed with golden red onion, crisp bacon, cream, egg and Parmesan.

source.title: Pasta with Onion, Bacon & Cream (PCB)
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 150 g dried pasta (1 very large serving)
1 tbsp kosher salt, for the pasta water
50 ml (3 1/2 tbsp) reserved pasta water, plus more as needed
Coarsely ground black pepper, to taste

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the kosher salt. Cook the pasta until 1 to 2 minutes short of al dente. Scoop out about 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Fry the onion for 5-7 min, stirring often, until soft and golden. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the bacon, raise the heat to medium, and cook 3-4 min until crisp.
Add the drained pasta to the skillet with the cream and the 50 ml of pasta water. Stir constantly over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until the pasta is al dente and the cream clings to it.

Take the pan off the heat and let it sit 30 seconds. Stir in the whisked egg and the Parmesan quickly until the sauce turns silky. Loosen with a little more cream or pasta water if it tightens. Finish with plenty of coarse black pepper.
tips: Add the egg off the heat so it thickens without scrambling.
Lidia Bastianich's spaghetti with egg, onion and bacon whisks the yolks with 1/4 cup of hot pasta water before they go in, which makes the egg even harder to scramble.

references.title: Spaghetti With Egg, Onion, and Bacon
